Privacy Policy — DartScore Pro for Android

Effective date: 18 October 2026

Who we are

DartScore Pro, also listed on Google Play as Darts Counter: Dart Score Pro, is provided by Miroslav Randáček under the developer name RandaCzech Studio.

Data controller: Miroslav Randáček
Address: Nad mlýnem 153, 10400 Praha, Czechia
Privacy contact: randaczechstudio@gmail.com

This policy covers the Android app.

Game data on your device

The app stores player names, scores, unfinished games, match history, statistics and preferences locally on your device.

Game analytics use selected information about app usage, rather than complete saved match records. Game analytics events do not include player names.

You can remove local data by clearing the app’s storage in Android settings. Backup and restoration may also depend on your device settings and backup provider.

Analytics

The app uses Google Analytics for Firebase to understand usage and improve the app.

Events may describe starting, completing or abandoning a game, game mode, number of players, game duration, and starting a Premium purchase or activating Premium.

Firebase may also process app-instance identifiers, advertising identifiers, app lifecycle events, approximate location derived from IP addresses, and purchase information. These data are not necessarily anonymous.

Analytics is currently configured to retain event data for 2 months and user data for 14 months. New user activity resets the user-data retention period. These limits do not apply to all aggregated reports.

Advertising

The app integrates Google AdMob / Google Mobile Ads and mediation adapters for Unity Ads and Meta Audience Network. Partner participation depends on the advertising configuration.

Advertising services may process IP addresses, approximate location, device or app identifiers, ad interactions and diagnostic information. Purposes include delivering and measuring advertising, analytics, fraud prevention and security.

The app’s web content also includes a Google AdSense script, which may contact Google when loaded.

Consent and your choices

Where required, advertising consent choices are presented through Google User Messaging Platform. Available privacy options depend on your region and the applicable consent requirements.

Declining personalised advertising does not necessarily stop all technical processing or Firebase Analytics collection. Advertising consent controls and device advertising-ID settings should not be understood as a general Analytics opt-out.

Where processing requires consent, you have the right to withdraw that consent. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal. Contact us if you need assistance with your privacy choices.

Premium purchases

Premium is a one-time purchase processed through Google Play Billing.

The app receives purchase information, including the product identifier, purchase status and purchase token, to verify ownership, acknowledge purchases and unlock Premium. It does not receive your full payment-card or bank-account details.

Premium purchase and activation events may also be recorded in Analytics. Purchasing Premium does not itself disable Analytics.

Voice announcements

Voice announcements use operating-system text-to-speech services. This feature does not record your voice.

Processing by a text-to-speech service depends on your selected provider and device settings.

Purposes and legal bases

Providing requested app functions and processing Premium entitlements may require processing necessary to perform our agreement with you.

Where consent is required for analytics, advertising or access to information on your device, that processing requires your consent. Necessary security, fraud-prevention and support activities may rely on legitimate interests, subject to your rights and applicable law. Processing required by law relies on the relevant legal obligation.

This policy does not itself obtain consent. Continued use of the app is not treated as consent to optional processing.

Service providers and international processing

Depending on the features used and service configuration, data may be processed by Google, Unity, Meta, operating-system service providers and device backup providers. Providers may act as processors or as independent controllers, depending on the service and processing purpose. Google Analytics is listed among Google’s processor services; standard AdMob and AdSense services generally fall under its controller terms.

Providers may process data outside your country, including outside the European Economic Area. The applicable transfer arrangements depend on the provider, service and contractual terms. Google describes its transfer mechanisms in its Data Transfer Frameworks notice. Unity describes adequacy decisions and Standard Contractual Clauses in its player privacy policy.

  • Google Privacy Policy
  • Firebase Privacy and Security
  • Google Data Transfer Frameworks
  • Unity Game Player and App User Privacy Policy
  • Meta Privacy Policy

You may contact us for information about recipients and safeguards relevant to your data.

Retention, deletion and security

Local game data remains on your device until overwritten or cleared. Clearing local data does not automatically delete information already transmitted to analytics, advertising or payment services.

Providers retain data according to the relevant service settings, processing purposes and legal obligations. Analytics retention settings are described above.

Google states that Firebase Analytics and Google Mobile Ads encrypt collected user data in transit. Device security and backup protection also depend on your operating system and settings.

The app does not offer user-account registration or a dedicated in-app mechanism for requesting deletion of remotely processed data. Privacy requests can be sent to our contact email.

Your rights

Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction of processing or data portability, and object to certain processing.

Send requests to randaczechstudio@gmail.com. We may need proportionate information to verify your identity or locate the relevant records. We do not require you to send passwords or payment-card details.

Where the GDPR applies, we normally respond within one month. If a permitted extension is necessary, we will explain it within that period.

You may lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. In Czechia, this is the Office for Personal Data Protection.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when the app or its data practices change. The published version will state its effective date.
